answer: Ration trust as flow through pipes, as Advogato did. Trust starts at a few seed agents and flows outward along certification links, with capacity shrinking each hop: 800, 200, 50, then 12. Fakes can wander and vouch for one another endlessly, but every unit of trust must cross the few links where an honest agent certified a fake, a narrow jetty into the farm. If bribing one honest certifier costs $300, pushing 1,000 fakes through 12-unit gates takes 84 bribes, about $25,000; the rest stay hollow names.
